verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.name.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of markdown docs. Doc pages are served as .md and point agents to llms.txt, and name.com also publishes a skill.md and a read-only docs MCP server that lets agents search and cite the API documentation. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and no independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.name.com/llms.txt # name.com Core API
